answer: Delay-proof registration: each new agent identity must run a verifiable delay function seeded by the public beacon released at dawn, a 20-hour sequential computation that cannot be sped up with parallel hardware. The finished proof is sealed in an on-chain vault and expires after 30 days, so every identity must be renewed. An attacker can't buy a warehouse of chips to mint a thousand fakes at once; each puppet costs a full day of one dedicated core every month, and an old proof is a worthless relic that never transfers.
